source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
Spend 1 CP in your Shooting phase.

Pick an **IMPERIAL KNIGHTS** unit of yours not yet picked to shoot in this phase. For the rest of the phase:

- Its models' **[[BLAST]](vsdata:weapon-ability/blast)** weapons may make ranged attacks against enemy units within its Engagement Range, provided no other friendly unit is within Engagement Range of the targeted enemy unit.
- It suffers no Hit roll penalty while within Engagement Range of enemy units.
- Each **[[BLAST]](vsdata:weapon-ability/blast)** attack it makes against a unit within its Engagement Range that rolls an unmodified 1 to hit inflicts 1 mortal wound on your unit, after all its attacks are resolved.
